winning_hook_formulas: The 'Urgent Warning' formula: [Emoji] + [Action/Behavior] + [Immediate Negative Consequence] (e.g., Stop doing X before you lose Y)
The 'Broken Dream' formula: [Emoji] + [Common Financial Goal] + [Hidden Reality/Barrier] (e.g., Why your goal of X is failing because of Y)
script_directives: Front-load the pain point: Deliver the primary conflict within the first 3 seconds to prevent immediate scroll-off.
Eliminate fluff: Use high-density information where every sentence provides a specific, actionable financial insight.
Visual anchoring: Use on-screen text overlays for key numbers or support levels to keep the viewer's eyes engaged with the screen.
seo_directives: Use high-intent keywords in the title that address specific financial fears (e.g., 'Stop', 'Trap', 'Critical').
Include a mix of broad finance hashtags (#StockMarketIndia, #PersonalFinance) and specific niche tags related to the video's technical content.
